mapper.insert: insert into t_payment_record (enterprise_id, payable_id, amount, pay_method, pay_time, voucher_url, operator_id, operator_name, remark, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{payableId}, #{amount}, #{payMethod}, sysdate(), #{voucherUrl}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{remark}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select payment_id as paymentId, payable_id as payableId, amount as amount, pay_method as payMethod, pay_time as payTime, voucher_url as voucherUrl, operator_name as operatorName, remark as remark, create_time as createTime from t_payment_record where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and payable_id = #{payableId} order by payment_id desc
